events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Festival kicked off. Three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What's your favourite performance from the legendary event?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost a true legend. Remembering Elvis Presley, whose music continues to inspire generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 29 years ago today, a shooting in Las Vegas tragically impacted the world of hip-hop. Remembering the undeniable influence and artistry of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On this day in 1970, we lost a guitar pioneer, Jimi Hendrix. His innovative sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, that music... pure genius. What's your favourite track from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending happy birthday wishes to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! A true rock icon with a voice that still commands attention.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released in the UK. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched a device that changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over 60 years of cinematic espionage. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the iconic John Lennon. A visionary artist whose music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your favourite track from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: On this day in 1991, the world lost an irreplaceable talent, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your top Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965 in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant artistic shift and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track?
